purpose: Define canonical operation identity, inputs, outputs, errors and side effects as explicit semantics so projections, UIs, routines and mechanisms invoke the same operation rather than creating private backend behavior.

topics.name: Operations
topics.purpose: Define canonical operation identity, inputs, outputs, errors and side effects as explicit semantics so projections, UIs, routines and mechanisms invoke the same operation rather than creating private backend behavior.

semantics.identity_rule: Operations are referenced by explicit operation identity.
semantics.effect_rule: Side effects are explicit. A read/evaluation operation with no declared side effects cannot cause hidden mutation or external effects.
semantics.authority_rule: Operation existence and authority to invoke it remain separate.
semantics.projection_rule: Editors/UIs/projections invoke canonical operations; they do not implement private semantic backends.
semantics.routine_rule: Routine steps call canonical operations/commands through Core dispatch and do not bypass operation/effect validation.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant meaning is explicit structured canonical data and is not reconstructed by hidden heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: operation has hidden undeclared side effect
projection/editor implements private semantic mutation instead of canonical operation
operation identity resolved by display name/path heuristic
operation invocation bypasses applicable authority validation
routine or mechanism bypasses declared operation/effect semantics

references.purpose: Operation existence and authority remain separate.
Canonical writes occur through explicit authoritative operations/change targets.
Derived UIs/views remain projections over canonical operations.

prose.summary: Define canonical operation identity, inputs, outputs, errors and side effects as explicit semantics so projections, UIs, routines and mechanisms invoke the same operation rather than creating private backend behavior.
